thread:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — draft outbound for tenants impacted by yesterday's token-throttle wave is ready. Includes short RCA, mitigation steps, and a credit offer. Need review + sign-off for enterprise + mid-market lists.
Mira Patel: thanks alex. can you share the affected segments + counts? we should prioritize renewals.
Samir Gomez: affected = ~72 tenants flagged, 18 enterprise, 22 mid-market, rest small. most saw degraded embed throughput for ~45m during the peak.
Alex Chen: right. root cause = autoscaler mis-evaluation combining short-burst traffic with cold cache; fallback routing didn't kick fast enough. full RCA below.
CS Bot: INCIDENT-2026-03-22 created — severity P2. Notifying on-call.
Jordan Lee: quick question — are we proposing credits or extended trial for enterprise? pricing/sales will need language.
Alex Chen: proposing a one-time service credit equal to 10% of last month's invoice for enterprise, 5% for mid-market, and a free month of premium support for affected high-touch customers. draft email snippet:
```
Hi {Customer},

We're sorry for the service disruption you experienced on Mar 22. Our investigation found a throttling cascade caused by autoscaler mis-evaluation that temporarily limited embedding throughput. We've implemented a fix to the autoscaler logic, added a routed fallback to reserve capacity for live requests, and improved cache warm-start on rollout.\n
Mitigation we applied: automated fallback rules, manual pool increase for impacted regions, and a temporary relaxation of token throttle thresholds while we validate stability.\n
What we're offering: a one-time credit and an invite to a live office hours session to walk through impact & remediation.\n
If you'd like a tailored postmortem call, reply and we'll schedule.\n
— Redwood CS
```
Mira Patel: looks good. add a short bullet for "what we changed" to be very clear for enterprise legal/finance teams.
Alex Chen: will add 3 bullets. also adding link to incident postmortem doc (internal) and a scheduled office hours: Thu 10am PT.
Samir Gomez: pinging @sales_ops — we should queue up the renewal owners for the enterprise list so they can reach out 1:1 after the outbound.
Jordan Lee: suggest we split outbound into two templates: one brief status for SRE customers and a slightly longer one for execs (impact + credit + next steps).
Alex Chen: agreed. I'll update and push two variants to this thread by EOD. please review once posted. sending timeline: prepped email -> cs lead review -> legal quick check -> send Wed morning.
Mira Patel: i'll prep the customer list and send to you for segmentation.
Samir Gomez: after send, CS should run a follow-up survey (simple 3 q) and capture NPS/qualitative notes in the ticket.
CS Bot: Reminder: incident page updated with mitigation verification at 4987654338.
Alex Chen: perfect. thanks all — plan to post final drafts here in ~3 hrs. :thumbsup:
